subtitle: The crest eagle has slipped its chain. Fly it over Cambridge.
facts: The Samuel Butler Room was founded in 1960.
Samuel Butler studied at St John's from 1854 to 1858.
The SBR room is at I2, First Court.
The GSR is at 1 All Saints Passage.
BA Table: Tuesdays and Fridays in term.
Port & Sherry: Fridays after hall, GBP1.50.
The SBR room has a TV with a Wii, a pool table and a piano.
St John's was founded in 1511 by Lady Margaret Beaufort.
The eagle is the emblem of St John the Evangelist.
The Chapel is by George Gilbert Scott, finished in 1869.
Swaps run with Balliol, Trinity College Dublin, Ghislieri and Uppsala.
Post: The Samuel Butler Room, St John's College, CB2 1TP.
